programme.desc: 在日本南部的九州和四国,廖崇明发现了一个充满活力、温馨的文化,该地的美食跟人民一样迷人。

programme.title: 起司爱旅 #1
programme.desc: 起司大师阿弗林・普里斯汀的起司探险之旅从阿尔卑斯山国瑞士展开,这里是格鲁耶尔与经典孔洞艾门塔起司的故乡。

programme.title: 起司爱旅 #2
programme.desc: 在法国,吃起司几乎是一项全民嗜好。阿弗林走访巴黎到诺曼第,探索全国各地悠久而丰富的起司制作历史。

programme.title: 起司爱旅 #3
programme.desc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的浓厚起司传统,当地家族乳酪坊的技艺世代相传,延续至今。

programme.title: 洪堡凉流 #1
programme.desc: 在智利托雷斯德尔潘恩,雪山融水注入指状峡湾,延伸至海洋并汇入洋流,降低海水盐度。河口、湿地孕育众多涉禽,而无数海湾与港口则吸引稀有的海豚与虎鲸。

programme.title: 洪堡凉流 #2
programme.desc: 洪堡洋流虽比多数洋流缓慢,却是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行经距离极长。深海海沟的涌升流将养分带至海面,使浮游植物大量繁盛,奠定复杂海洋食物链的基础。

programme.title: 洪堡凉流 #3
programme.desc: 这股洋流伴随著智利独特的蓝鲸族群,也是其他极度稀有海洋哺乳动物的最后避风港。从冰冷深海到高崖强风,洋流塑造出奇特栖地,也是一部关于生存的自然研究。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #1
programme.desc: 来认识这些异常的微型动物,牠们利用娇小的身躯在世上最致命的环境中克险求生。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #2
programme.desc: 体型异常庞大的动物就需要异常的适应力。从巨大的鲸鱼到森林怪物,这些就是自然巨人的史诗式生存故事。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #3
programme.desc: 日入而作可带来极端的挑战,同时亦带来巨大的机会。在这没有光的世界,危险在每个角落蛰伏。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #4
programme.desc: 当冬季来临,气温骤降,食物亦变得稀缺。但有些动物已经进化出独特的适应力,能够在世上最冷、最贫瘠的环境中繁衍。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面纱 #3
programme.desc: 跟我们一起前往哥斯达黎加的心脏,发现几个伊甸园般的美妙生物群落,并察看每天保育,有时则是恢复这一特别自然遗产前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 灰熊的故事: 双孤记
programme.desc: 凯西安达臣抚养一只名叫砵突士的熊孤儿18年后,将尽一切努力确保没有熊生活在人造庇护所中。有一年,当他得知有两只灰熊幼崽成为孤儿后,他的决心受到考验。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #1
programme.desc: 来认识这些异常的微型动物,牠们利用娇小的身躯在世上最致命的环境中克险求生。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #2
programme.desc: 体型异常庞大的动物就需要异常的适应力。从巨大的鲸鱼到森林怪物,这些就是自然巨人的史诗式生存故事。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #1
programme.desc: 奥克兰动物园的灵长类小组准备迎接新生。

programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 09 meters in size and live over 100 years But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful How to keep your turtles healthy? programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #19
programme.desc: 乌野高中在看台上观看伊达工业高中对上青叶城西高中的比赛。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #20
programme.desc: 青叶城西高中对上乌野高中,并很快就把一名改变比赛节奏的新球员换上场。

programme.title: 机动战士高达 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #20
programme.desc: 古尔发现沙迪克是绑架萨里乌斯的幕后策划者。

programme.title: 机动战士高达 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #21
programme.desc: 由于诺蕾雅的愤怒,阿斯蒂卡西亚技术学院被摧毁。 米奥莉奈回来后感到内疚。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #2
programme.desc: 在FOS的线下活动中茜偶然发现山田的身影。然而在与前男友碰面时,茜一时冲动,将山田介绍为自己的男朋友。后来茜喝得烂醉如泥,被山田带到家中照顾。不小心弄丢饰品的茜为了寻回失物而在游戏里联络山田,结果不但被他冷淡对待,还被批评不会使用武器库。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #3
programme.desc: 茜登入FOS后,发现公会会长琉璃姬与山田也在线。虽然山田平时就像他的「能面」角色一样冷淡,但他对琉璃姬却一直表现得很亲近,这让茜怀疑他们其实是情侣关系,她逐渐意识到自己对山田的情感。之后茜收到了琉璃姬的线下聚会邀请,并答应见面。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #8
programme.desc: 除了饭店经营外还发展各种事业的音无集团会长・音无刚一要求私下和琴子会面。他的妻子曾在路上遇到劫匪,因此丧命。刚一对琴子坦承是他间接害死了妻子,时日无多的刚一希望将自己是杀人犯的事实详细告诉孩子们。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #9
programme.desc: 刚一出了一道课题,要家人说明自己在二十三年前杀害妻子澄的真相,谁能做出最合理的解释,便能得到优先继承财产的权利。他的亲属纷纷试图解开课题,琴子却突然提出一个问题。为何刚一的小孩恰好都有不在场证明?之后事态迎来意外的发展。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #20

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #21

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #8
programme.desc: 夕香等人看到了阿久津和莉莉一起从公寓中出来。尽管他们迫切地想要澄清他们并没有共度一晚,但班上的同学却没有那么容易放弃追问……这时候,夕香对阿久津提出了一个出乎意料的建议……她居然邀请他去约会……!?

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #9
programme.desc: 莉莉的素体「莉莉亚」突然来到学校上课。由于她说她是以姊姊的身分,代替因感冒而缺席的莉莉来上课的,学校便特别允许了这件事。在课堂上不时找碴的莉莉亚让阿久津越来越警戒。然而午休时,莉莉亚却突然把阿久津叫了出去。

programme.title: 久保同学不放过我 #11
programme.desc: 喜欢的漫画翻拍而成的电影将在周五上映,曾被白石同学推荐看这部漫画的久保同学借机邀他去看电影。当天和打扮可爱且绑著马尾的久保同学前往电影院的白石同学因存在感薄弱而被人忽视,身旁的久保同学被男生搭讪后显得一脸困扰,白石同学将有何反应?

programme.title: 久保同学不放过我 #12
programme.desc: 白石同学在4月25日迎来生日,像往常不被人祝贺的他完全没有主角该有的样子。不过他肚子却大声咕咕叫,意外受到同学瞩目。久保同学知道他很饿后将巧克力交给感到难为情的白石同学,包装上写著祝福他生日的话语。她总是关注著白石同学的原因究竟为何?

programme.desc: 音无莉音与亮马回顾遭杀害的澄度过的一生。澄总是遵从父亲音无传次郎决定的方针,献上自己的人生促进集团发展。不料那套成功法则却不持久,本来被逼到崩毁边缘的集团因为澄的命案得以脱离危机。莉音分析事情原委后,宣称自己可能得知了事件真相。

programme.desc: 莉莉的素体「莉莉亚」突然来到学校上课。由于她说她是以姊姊的身分,代替因感冒而缺席的莉莉来上课的,学校便特别允许了这件事。在课堂上不时找碴的莉莉亚让阿久津越来越警戒。然而午休时,莉莉亚却突然把阿久津叫了出去。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎维」突然出现在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那绅士风度般的态度当中所隐含的某种令人生畏的气息给震撼,莉莉则是丢下他和扎维一同离去。阿久津很在意莉莉离去时那不自然的笑容,当他追上他们两人时,他看到因为被扎维拿刀指著而吓得浑身发抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #5
programme.desc: 趁著宅邸内一片混乱之际,莱利娜的前未婚夫布鲁克斯将她绑走。在马车中清醒过来的莱利娜尝试说服绑匪们放走自己,毫不意外地以失败告终。但她仍抓住马车因车轮损坏而停下来的破绽逃入森林之中。当她心想总算能穿过树丛的那一瞬间,有人抓住了她的手。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #6
programme.desc: 莱利娜不小心在努尔的马上睡著了。当她在隔天早上醒来时,发现自己睡在努尔的卧房,旁边还躺著赤裸著上半身的他。莱利娜在情急之下拜托亚当帮她逃离此处。被留在房间的努尔命令执事长奇德翁动员所有骑士搜寻两人,但莱利娜早已为了躲避搜索而假扮成女仆。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 莱利娜收到了弗丽丝答应给她的,于锡克雷特山脉召开的魔物讨伐战邀请函。依照讨伐战惯例,女性将赠送手帕给男性,男性则会将捕捉到的魔物献给女性。努尔之前从未收下任何人的手帕,也从未献上魔物给任何人。到了讨伐战当日,努尔对莱利娜提出了某项要求。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努尔将被称作山之主的魔物献给了莱利娜后,让两人的距离从原本的契约关系逐渐开始有了变化,却也让莱利娜的命运笼罩在不祥的阴影之中。薇薇安对努尔抱有好感,却连点燃神殿圣火的使命都被莱利娜夺走而怀恨在心,而此时,有一个人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 海贼王 #19
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #1
programme.desc: 女大生木之下茜遭遇了一场突如其来的悲剧--她被男友甩掉,理由是他喜欢上在网路游戏「救世主之森(FOS)」认识的女生。茜在FOS里靠攻击弱小角色发泄情绪,并遇见同属一个公会的山田。茜不经意间向他倾诉与恋人分手的事,导致大大改变了她的人生。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #2
programme.desc: 在FOS的线下活动中茜偶然发现山田的身影。然而在与前男友碰面时,茜一时冲动,将山田介绍为自己的男朋友。后来茜喝得烂醉如泥,被山田带到家中照顾。不小心弄丢饰品的茜为了寻回失物而在游戏里联络山田,结果不但被他冷淡对待,还被批评不会使用武器库。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #3
programme.desc: 茜登入FOS后,发现公会会长琉璃姬与山田也在线。虽然山田平时就像他的「能面」角色一样冷淡,但他对琉璃姬却一直表现得很亲近,这让茜怀疑他们其实是情侣关系,她逐渐意识到自己对山田的情感。之后茜收到了琉璃姬的线下聚会邀请,并答应见面。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #9
programme.desc: 莉莉的素体「莉莉亚」突然来到学校上课。由于她说她是以姊姊的身分,代替因感冒而缺席的莉莉来上课的,学校便特别允许了这件事。在课堂上不时找碴的莉莉亚让阿久津越来越警戒。然而午休时,莉莉亚却突然把阿久津叫了出去。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎维」突然出现在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那绅士风度般的态度当中所隐含的某种令人生畏的气息给震撼,莉莉则是丢下他和扎维一同离去。阿久津很在意莉莉离去时那不自然的笑容,当他追上他们两人时,他看到因为被扎维拿刀指著而吓得浑身发抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 海贼王 #19

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #5
programme.desc: 趁著宅邸内一片混乱之际,莱利娜的前未婚夫布鲁克斯将她绑走。在马车中清醒过来的莱利娜尝试说服绑匪们放走自己,毫不意外地以失败告终。但她仍抓住马车因车轮损坏而停下来的破绽逃入森林之中。当她心想总算能穿过树丛的那一瞬间,有人抓住了她的手。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #6
programme.desc: 莱利娜不小心在努尔的马上睡著了。当她在隔天早上醒来时,发现自己睡在努尔的卧房,旁边还躺著赤裸著上半身的他。莱利娜在情急之下拜托亚当帮她逃离此处。被留在房间的努尔命令执事长奇德翁动员所有骑士搜寻两人,但莱利娜早已为了躲避搜索而假扮成女仆。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 莱利娜收到了弗丽丝答应给她的,于锡克雷特山脉召开的魔物讨伐战邀请函。依照讨伐战惯例,女性将赠送手帕给男性,男性则会将捕捉到的魔物献给女性。努尔之前从未收下任何人的手帕,也从未献上魔物给任何人。到了讨伐战当日,努尔对莱利娜提出了某项要求。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努尔将被称作山之主的魔物献给了莱利娜后,让两人的距离从原本的契约关系逐渐开始有了变化,却也让莱利娜的命运笼罩在不祥的阴影之中。薇薇安对努尔抱有好感,却连点燃神殿圣火的使命都被莱利娜夺走而怀恨在心,而此时,有一个人暗中接近她。

programme.desc: 女大生木之下茜遭遇了一场突如其来的悲剧--她被男友甩掉,理由是他喜欢上在网路游戏「救世主之森(FOS)」认识的女生。茜在FOS里靠攻击弱小角色发泄情绪,并遇见同属一个公会的山田。茜不经意间向他倾诉与恋人分手的事,导致大大改变了她的人生。

programme.desc: 在FOS的线下活动中茜偶然发现山田的身影。然而在与前男友碰面时,茜一时冲动,将山田介绍为自己的男朋友。后来茜喝得烂醉如泥,被山田带到家中照顾。不小心弄丢饰品的茜为了寻回失物而在游戏里联络山田,结果不但被他冷淡对待,还被批评不会使用武器库。

programme.desc: 悦发现亨父佐敦将来港，更明白亨讹称在港有女友。若被揭穿，亨势要回印度。亨发现高丽与佐敦皆是任白迷，亨求高丽扮其女友哄老父开心，不过双方见面当日，丽与佐敦竟因对任白的见解不同，不欢而散。

programme.title: 天龙八部#25粤普PG
programme.desc: 虚竹在童姥死前答应做灵鹫宫主人，之后帮众人破解生死符，与段誉结拜。坦之受冠清怂恿竞逐丐帮帮主，在比武大会胜出成为帮主，萧峰接报发现阿紫求救记号，要去中原救她。西夏国王招婿，家臣劝慕容复藉联姻以助复国。

programme.title: 阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 桑基鱼塘是良性循环的耕种模式，桑叶、鲩鱼同时入馔，带来无比口福。在顺德均安尝过美味，阿谭回港想再「安歌」，鼎爷转用开边豆角、火腩炒鱼肠，事前洗涤功夫不容马虎，厨桌上的三盆水各有用途！火锅吃法甚获顺德人欢心，粥水火锅可让食材更香滑。鼎爷对阿谭的口甜舌滑亦相当受落，为她炮制「酒香鸡」与「腊肉芋头焖牛肉」。鼎爷提醒烹煮药膳菜式，需注意食材配搭。此外，要令腊肉更易出味、牛肉又较易吸取油香，有何简易方法？

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 银屑病是慢性自身免疫系统疾病，除了影响皮肤外，还可扩展至关节，衍生共病「银屑病关节炎」。此症与一般关节炎相比，休息后的不适反会加重；风湿病科医生还会细说相关临床诊断、治疗方法。殿堂级DJ区瑞强、周国丰、郑子诚到临录影厂，分享在DJ行业遇过的趣事。身为DJ，先决条件是听音乐够广、观察力及敏感度高。曾有受访嘉宾于广播其间不慎说了粗口，令经验丰富的他们亦大吃一惊！「睇𩠌食饭」，傅季馨示范「番茄烩牛脷」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在东莞粤
programme.desc: 东莞现时被称为「潮玩之都」，加上国产IP近几年大放光彩，祖蓝当然要带大家认识一下东莞原创原产的潮玩IP！聚焦南城街道区域，本集除了潮玩当然亦会「潮食」，一间供应自家海钓水产的海鲜餐厅，还有一家由近千年学堂改建的西式餐饮店，将东莞的潮流与个性，都体验得淋漓尽致。

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#4粤
programme.desc: 秀琼跌倒后脚肿如猪蹄；司徒岚到豆品厂时发现兆明竟是公司顾问，怕被他看见急忙躲起来。兆明为员工安排连串训练课程；司徒岚欲告诉兆明秀琼是她母亲，惜错失良机。第一个训练以打野战形式进行，最后剩下秀琼和兆明对峙……第二个训练「创新思维」，仅威龙成功到达终点。最后一个训练「听教练的话」，大家不明兆明指令，做到手忙脚乱。兆明向众人作出评估和检讨；兆明指斥秀琼扰乱秩序，威龙为秀琼仗义执言。兆明与秀琼势成水火……

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT!粤日
programme.desc: 悠转学到一织和环班上，成为同班同学。壮五遇到虎于，被对方以家事和环的身世作出挑衅。MEZZO"将有自己的电台节目。百坚持去见了，与千吵了一架。了得知百曾向千下跪，对事情始末深感兴趣。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 做运动也可以有相对静态的动作，这回「WORKOUT 2GETHER」先藉伸展运动拉松筋腱，并提升柔韧度。头侧向一方，一只手轻压头部，另一只手放腰间，可伸展斜方肌；双手互扣，身体向前倾，就似向前版本的「伸懒腰」。这些动作要慢慢做，以免扭伤。接下来要加强运动量，展开「全身肌力及协调训练」。抬起单脚斜向摆动，有助训练肌力，同时考验平衡力。双手交叉挥动夹踢腿动作；交叉踏步配合拍手节奏，少点协调力也不行！

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 今天是万圣节，乐园学园一年级生要盛装打扮，向老师与前辈讨糖果。学园还有一个万圣节传闻，据说「无法开启的门」一经打开，奇迹就会发生。千依对奇迹之门充满兴趣，继而找来阳葵与美月，一起调查那扇门的秘密。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝粤
programme.desc: 旅游业一直是香港重要经济支柱，外国游客到香港，究竟想观看甚么？古老的祠堂，或是别具风味的棚屋？十年如一日的景点，对游客是否还有吸引力？新闻掏宝和大家重温2003年专题。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 司机途经观塘绕道时拍到，一辆载人电单车的装备袋着火仍继续行驶，燃烧物品在路面四散，情况相当危险。匹克球于近年备受欢迎，香港多区都有市民参与这运动。有屋邨中层住户却控诉，不时有人在楼下的户外球场打匹克球，击球声犹如敲门般，造成持续滋扰。学者从物理学角度分析匹克球击球声为何扰民；大律师则提供相关噪音条例的法律资讯。谭辉智于新歌MV公开成长照，送上拍摄花絮。不少都市人有脂肪肝问题，可有方法改善？

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2762粤
programme.desc: 国际知名的战地记者将在本地举办作品拍卖会，他多年前曾于战乱地区英勇救下一名小孩，因而受人敬仰。树仁却向熊家众人宣称该记者抢去他的功劳，却并无凭据。树仁偶然找到当年获救小孩手持的特别版游戏卡，并知悉该卡如今价值连城，却拒绝转售牟利。树根等人企图改变他的决定，但屡试不果。拍卖会当天，当年获救的小孩亲身到场，树仁打算凭游戏卡与他相认，借此揭穿该记者的谎言，讵料……

programme.title: X Wallet呈献:卧底娇娃#14粤PG
programme.desc: 佳琪查到爱邦妮旗下某单位电费不寻常，与奕风前往查探，终发现索帕与学年暗中勾结。刘彪突然来到索帕家，原来是他指使索帕陷害学年。丽荃向大韦哭诉自己遭学年胁逼参与非法赌档、甚至可能运毒事宜，大韦大发雷霆，要踢学年出四联商会；佳琪与奕风暗中偷听，更确信学年是粉精灵的上线。小茹从洗衣店找到嘉盈留下的线索，怀疑与粉精灵有关。警方与国际刑警合作要捣破网上赌场，奕风竟出现救走学年，但学年否认自己是粉精灵的上线……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈献：机智女法医2#6粤普PG
programme.desc: 祐辰安问楚楚为何信任萧瑾瑜，楚楚表示自己是萧瑾瑜的下属，萧瑾瑜会保护每个下属，下属也会为萧瑾瑜拼命；景翊和冷月去教坊找沁香，沁香还是什么都不愿说；萧瑾瑜和皇帝喝酒，提出让楚楚重新解剖，皇帝最后答应了。

programme.title: 中国建设银行(亚洲)呈献：攻你上大学粤
programme.desc: 《中年好声音》团队集结「考场」！第一关问到母亲节日期，肥妈、车婉婉、周国丰、张佳添、海儿、谷娅溦、周吉佩、支喾仪、黄剑文、赵浚承全部升班。小二乘数题同样大赠送，吉吉竟质疑是IQ题？及后剑文接连「出猫」，换来教训！中一题涉及制作萝卜糕，「优异生」以AI锦囊过关，喾仪却以丈夫英文名来答题？婉婉为拍摄「中音」特意找普通话老师补习，面对中二普通话读音理应没难度；文静老师揭晓答案前念出选项，各人便知正解。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#22粤
programme.desc: 嫪毐向少龙透露赵穆乃楚国春申君之私生子。陶方建议少龙乔装楚国马痴董匡，以贩马及假扮楚国密使接近赵穆。少龙在吕府重遇李斯，答应举荐他做嬴政的侍读。赵倩送平安符给少龙，少龙感动却不敢许下承诺。廷芳为筹钱请善柔杀嫪毐愿做杀手协助她，却险累死善柔。朱姬亲自下厨宴请不韦，不韦却不赴约，怒将菜肴扫跌。嫪毐怂恿朱姬好好把握秦王对她言听计从的机会，又握住其玉手，朱姬心神一荡。少龙抵达赵国即碰见琴清，顿时心思紊乱。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粤
programme.desc: 主持与十位艺员在购物城内疯狂玩乐！「吹杯过杯」只有连诗雅「食白果」，她在问答环节还要玩了半小时才知道「答问题要先举手」；相反，何君诚的表现令人喜出望外。众人斗快「不用手穿裤子」，黄美棋使出瑜伽动作、周志康化身人肉四驱车，怪招尽出。出线比赛坐飞毡赛跑，何雁诗被对手大幅抛离，幸好最后一棒是美棋对连诗雅，赛果可想而知！

高朋满座#53粤
programme.desc: 佐敦与丽闹翻，亨回印度的事不了了之。亨向丽勒索，更令人误会二人拍拖。丽向亨表示凡知道她富有的人三日内必定会意外死去，亨接连遇上怪事，往找丽求救。丽道出唯有说服其他人相信这个秘密，从而将诅咒转移给那人。

programme.title: 天龙八部#26粤普PG
programme.desc: 虚竹回少林寺，灵鹫宫四姑娘暗中跟随。哲罗星与清凉寺方丈来到少林寺，要求少林寺释放波罗星。少林寺则指波罗星偷学少林武功。期间鸠摩智前来挑战少林众长老，虚竹见状还击，却暴露了自己身上的逍遥派武功…

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷、阿谭一试压制虾膏，兼以大澳出产的靓虾酱蒸煮猪板筋，以烈酒腌猪肉有何作用？食材摆放次序原来足以影响菜式质素；再用虾膏带来「虾酱啫啫生菜」，简单易做。主持们在南海盐步搜罗各式茄子，见识特产秋茄的种植过程。二人制作「茹香茄子」迎合绿色星期一，以腐乳代替咸鱼，不失原材料的精髓，色香味俱全！另一道「清炒素五子」够健康，为何果仁需分开汆水？新鲜雪耳属时令食材，但无有怕，选用干雪耳亦可炒出鲜味。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 女性于更年期后因雌激素下降，患心血管疾病的风险大增。心脏科医生指男女的心脏病发的症状大有分别，女士如出现上背痛、上腹痛便要提高警觉。通波仔手术是心脏病的主流治疗，部份女患者却未必适合，有何原因？区瑞强、周国丰、郑子诚三位资深DJ将首次合作开骚，他们惺惺相惜，私下情谊深厚。国丰笑言担心唱歌时忘记歌词；子诚亦坦言对唱歌感忧虑，并感谢区瑞强的窝心支援。「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie师傅示范「鱼香茄子肉碎」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在东莞粤
programme.desc: 有没有一家店可一次过品尝东莞各地区的美食？在万江区，本集探店的这家酒楼就可以满足你，不仅如此，内里还附设一个甚具规模的东莞饮食风俗博物馆！大饱口福之后，祖蓝还带大家去「料」(玩)，行逛一个历史文化古村— 下坝坊，这里并不简单，游人于白天可以感受百年古镇的风情，夜晚就大变身，成为年轻人最爱「蒲」之地……

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#5粤

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 传统金器手工精巧，现代机器难以取代。主持人来到金舖欣赏各款名贵首饰，期间竟有人被称呼为「石狗公」，有何所指？花生糖保持古法人手炮制，昔日风味得以保存。麦美恩亲自拜师学习做糖，顺道细谈「石地板种花生」、「发霉花生」等歇后语。「老细」、「事头」何以成为上司代名词？且听中文讲师廖舜禧拆解。粤语逾二千年来原来甚少演变，故被视为古汉语「活化石」。廖舜禧追溯广府话历史，还从「锡」「勼」「冧」三字解构爱情真义！

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 荷里活电影被誉为业界殿堂，其历史可追溯至一百多年前。滢仴简介最早期的默片，以及有声与彩色电影的诞生过程。上世纪约七十年代被指是传统与新荷里活电影的分水岭，二者有何不同？来到千禧年，电影走进数码时代，另一谷主凯婷觉得电脑合成影像(CG)是最大特色。滢仴引述「派拉蒙法案」案例，它是影响上世纪美国影业发展的重大事件。踏入廿一世纪，串流平台兴起，也导致影业的生态再有大转变。此外，据说电影彩蛋与复活节有关？

programme.desc: 「好巿民奖」旨在彰显好人好事，带动社会守望相助、携手扑灭罪行。2025年度颁奖典礼于2026年3月14日在会展举行，并由区永权、陈庭欣担任司仪，凝聚好市民、好机构的正能量。各个获奖单位为协助警方破案、拯救生命、推动防罪灭罪作杰出贡献，TVB直播嘉许情况。单立文、张驰豪、周志康、郑俊弘、罗毓仪藉歌声鼓励一众无名英雄；男团Hey Brother献唱之余，还与林秀怡合演小剧场，宣扬好市民精神与防骗讯息。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，这次两项训练都集中于下身，听从儿童体适能教练的指示来完成吧！跟随拍子做运动，提起一只脚上下移动的同时，分别将一只手以钟摆形式摆动，以及举高、放低双手，可有难度？站立式的「踏单车」动作，有助增强下肢肌力与协调度。轮到「臀部训练」，以不同姿势坐于瑜伽垫上，利用臀部发力做锻练，亦可顺道伸展腰部。双手带动身体向后仰的动作，既可伸展颈部与胸大肌，练习得多就更易做到拱桥？

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 白色情人节将至，小丸子期盼丰厚回礼，冬田和小渚亦各自对心仪的男孩有所期待。小丸子从花轮口中得知古董的价值，于是偕同爷爷去逛废物市集，希望发掘到不为人知的宝物，借此发一笔横财。

programme.title: 潜行天下粤
programme.desc: 《潜行天下》以全球海洋为主题，采用8K超高清摄影机和水下无人机等技术建构沉浸式观影体验，跨越四大洋14国水域拍摄，记录双髻鲨、鲸鲨等海洋生物活动，探密三沙永乐龙洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 衞生署儿童体能智力测验中心，大约有七成新症在服务目标的6个月内完成评估，但部分个案声称要轮候年半至两年。轮候时间长，万一儿童错过六岁前的「黄金介入期」，对他们成长有多大影响呢？随著社会对特殊教育需要的认识和接受程度提升，预计怀疑个案会越来越多，政府可以如何加强服务，让这批小朋友及早获得评估及适切的治疗呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: K Cash业主私人贷款呈献 :香港系列之细间始终你好粤
programme.desc: 祥师兄所说全港最美味的墨鱼丸，是怎样制造的？粉面店第三代传人指重点是新鲜，猪肉丸亦是同样道理！店主偕同母亲传承祖传的味道，目标成为百年老店！婚礼摄影师锐意打造属于年轻人的新派旗袍，还提供化妆、摄影一条龙服务。祥师兄穿起店内唐装，再于街头拍照，大赞专业！湾仔一间小木屋其实是松饼小店，开店源于吃过英国松饼，但发觉在港难找到？小店也可发展为大公司，祥师兄走访本地个人护理用品厂房，CEO亦会细说经营理念。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈献:唱钱粤
programme.desc: 音准、拍子大考验，唱歌随时有钱落袋！两孩之母Mani继续冲击第二条提款线，更剑指「魔王之歌」？每年自资到录音室录歌的歌唱爱好者亦会接受《唱钱》洗礼，透过挑战Sing盘上不同歌曲难度「过三关」，甚至是最难的Monster关卡，向扫清九宫格的目标进发。观众只需用手机扫描萤幕上的QR Code，即可参与直播室互动，为挑战者打气，更有机会赢取福利。

programme.title: J Music粤
programme.desc: 吴崇铭发觉布志纶作品<如是因 如是果与自己的<挂念你 你好吗构思相若，于是带来「一晚限定」的混唱合作，两人亦分别送上甜蜜情歌<一家之主与<贴地，志纶还有忠粉到场支持偶像。张驰豪新推出<一个人的生日歌，旨在为孤单人士送上力量。独立歌手Young Hysan唱出他的<道歉启示。冯熙燮细谈独立组合时期与现时成为签约歌手的大不同，并感谢T-Rexx将其心路历程，写进<聆听自己的声音歌词内。

programme.title: 风味人间 第2季粤
programme.desc: 蓝蟹是梭子蟹的分支，美国马里兰人爱蒸熟后撒上当地香料，味道咸香辛辣。日本厨师是拆蟹达人，能将香箱蟹拆肉后再拼回原只奉客。美国人则喜欢将蟹拆肉，混合面包糠、蛋黄酱等造蟹饼，酥香可口。螃蟹脱壳后，会暂时变为肉少的水蟹，澳门人看准其特性，煮成水蟹粥，鲜甜滋味。江苏一带会将蟛蜞捣碎过滤煮成「豆腐」，软滑鲜香。将生蟹加盐腌制的炝蟹，是浙江的地道美食。韩国人亦擅于将生蟹腌制进食，酱油蟹更被喻为「白饭小偷」。

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 四位香港杰出学生运动员奖得主细谈感受与目标，又会如何平衡学业与体育？U18男子冰球世锦赛，港队在尾场挫新西兰，以四胜一负成绩摘亚。曼联旧将朗尼庄臣来港参与足球活动，与小朋友交流，并回望「红魔」岁月。甲一篮球总决赛第三场，满贯与香港东方争逐领先优势。王玮骏、陈钰文于维港赛艇赛夺双人双桨艇金牌；另检视香港田径系列赛男、女飞人冲线时刻。这集还带来学界足球精英赛两场准决赛战报、青少年棍网球公开赛记招花絮。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤 及 天气报告粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 本地出生率持续创新低，但去年婴幼儿用品零售市场，反而逆市造好，为何会如此？中东局势紧张，一旦情况进一步恶化，对全球以至香港经济的影响多大？

programme.title: 叠影狙击#7粤PG
programme.desc: 诺召开记者会为公司丑闻致歉；晨到总公司履新，接到雄的来电。证物房起火，USB被烧毁，同时证人发亦被杀。KC以曦伪造文件的影片威胁晨助其加入总公司，结果反遭晨威胁。雄约晨见面，让晨在诺的办公室装监听器。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤
programme.desc: Ben Sir带队，联同祖仪、衍峰向上水古洞村出发，来到村内硕果仅存的旧式茶楼，桌上碌鹅、酿鲮鱼等菜肴，品尝传统客家风味。三人紧接前往马草垄迎接醉人日落，捕捉靓人靓景，轻松完成打卡之旅！衍峰、邝洁楹随萧欣浩博士寻找旧香港足迹，畅游上环歌赋街，享用港式美食，霸王鸭、金钱鸡有何来头？颖彤、黄庭锋实试几款设备齐全的本地露营车，还可观星、煮饭仔，适合二人世界。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 荷里活电影被誉为业界殿堂，其历史可追溯至一百多年前。滢仴简介最早期的默片，以及有声与彩色电影的诞生过程。上世纪约七十年代被指是传统与新荷里活电影的分水岭，二者有何不同？来到千禧年，电影走进数码时代，另一谷主凯婷觉得电脑合成影像(CG)是最大特色。滢仴引述「派拉蒙法案」案例，它是影响上世纪美国影业发展的重大事件。踏入廿一世纪，串流平台兴起，也导致影业的生态再有大转变。此外，据说电影彩蛋与复活节有关？

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 敏之、凯琳正享用丰富早餐之际，高Ling忽然带同杨明神秘回归，为姊妹送上惊喜！走进地道市场，四人兵分两路，尽情选购特色小食、用品。敏之、凯琳化身「头巾西施」推销商品，反应理想！杨明、高Ling紧接接受挑战，更出动「美男计」兜售头巾，生意又怎样？一行人登船前往停泊岛，迎接阳光与海滩。当地度假村设有不同类型的酒店房间，三位美女藉小游戏分房期间却与制作团队发生冲突……杨明细看之下，竟察觉当中有蛊惑？

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 香港近年成为全球最长寿地区，几位十岁出头的孩子又希望活到多少岁？在节目组和洪永城安排下，小朋友分成两组，第一组到学校，向校长及负责老师了解校内如何推行生死教育，并共同饲养一条「宠物鱼」。第二组前往山野接受求生技巧训练，掌握搭建帐篷后，一试野外捉鱼并随即动刀㓥鱼。活动尾声，两组人都有一条鱼作「食物报酬」，为何一边感到雀跃，另一边却愁云惨雾？养鱼组别当知道眼前蒸鱼并非所养的宠物鱼，心情和胃口大为转变！

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 本集将介绍沙特阿拉伯一种独特的编织工艺- 「阿尔萨度」贝都因人用阿尔萨度亲手为家庭制作所需的物品, 她们一边编织布料, 一边互相分享家人的消息, 阿尔萨度不只是织布技术, 更是一种团结家庭的集体艺术

programme.title: 翻生工程粤英
programme.desc: 工程师Rob Bell带大家探讨将废弃结构转变为未来建筑背后的重大挑战。

programme.title: 检索爱情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X张基龙大谈姐弟恋年下男狂撩职场女强人】聚焦于三位35岁女性——裴朵美、车贤和宋佳景，她们在职场和感情中勇敢追梦。这三位独立的女性，专注于自己的事业，成为职场上的佼佼者。然而在她们坚强的外表下，深藏著对爱情的渴望。尽管在追求梦想的道路上充满坎坷，她们依然坚信自己的抉择。在她们身后都有一位，用自己的方式默默守护的真命天子，以现实的笔触描绘了这三个女性在职场上的竞争和情感中的纠结，将粉红泡泡与现实的辛酸完美结合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 现在开始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 我的野蛮王妃
programme.desc: 【神级经典韩剧，尹恩惠、朱智勋、金桢勋、宋智孝再现现代宫廷指腹为婚！！】申采静原本只是一名平凡无奇的高中学生，得知爷爷的遗嘱中，她与皇太子李信有婚约在身。因家中债务的原因，在无可奈何的情况完婚。待在皇室的申采静对宫内生活十分反弹，此时海归回来的皇位第二继承者李律及李信前女友闵孝琳的存在，展开错综复杂的故事。

programme.title: 另一种蓝
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 时光之城(完)
programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 坏记忆橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中携陈世娫出演新剧《坏记忆橡皮擦》回归电视剧！！】曾是被看好的网球之星李君，在负伤之后丧失了自尊心，认为自己从人生的主角变成配角。遇上脑研究中心的医生景珠妍，使用了记忆橡皮擦抹去了过去记忆，重生为运动经纪人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初恋。因被篡改的记忆开始的罗曼史，在得知真相后其结局将会如何呢？

programme.title: 珠玉在侧
programme.desc: 【不务正业公子雯珺阴错阳差纳ㄚ环玉荐师徐璐！！】个性古灵精怪的单单单，一心想成为荐玉师却苦无机会，只能帮姐姐单双双卖些假玉，一次交易过程中无意得罪了富家玩绔公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突发危机单单单走投无路入府成为ㄚ环，府邸主人意外是裴沛，单单单也在调笑皆非中与裴沛逐渐相知相惜。

programme.desc: Stanley, Sophie and Benjamin make up a new game, 'Dino-Pirates'. This is such a good game, they use it as inspiration for Stanley's carnival float.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Bubbles
programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthia's bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. It's so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Shops
programme.desc: A series exploring maths in everyday scenarios. With catchy songs and fun animation.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Find Street Art
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran set off on a trail to find street art. Charlene is working on a special surprise for the end, and JoJo and Gran Gran tell everyone to make sure they see it.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Making Friends Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are off for a Jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Everglades National Park, Florida
programme.desc: The Go Jetters save the Florida Everglades when hungry alligators chase Glitch's picnic.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Orange
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits theatre, it's the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S1) - Cucumber
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp;amp; Fruits theatre, it's Cucumber performing Cool Under Pressure while trying to not let any obstacle ruin her calm routine.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - The Good, the Bad and the Prickly
programme.desc: Prickly Pear arrives in the Supermarket and tries to take over Evil Pea's freezer. Supertato discovers that Prickly Pear isn't mean at all and just needed some good friends.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - The Great Book Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea takes all the books from the Supermarket. Supertato, Chilli and Carrot try to rescue all the books by using acrobatic skills they learnt from their favourite circus book.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Love Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Stuck
programme.desc: All of the Teletubbies are stuck. Tinky Winky's hand is stuck in the bag, Dipsy's hat is stuck, Laa-Laa's ball is stuck and Po is stuck on the Tubby Slidey!

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - I Can Be Anything
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing and follow their dreams.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - The Friendship Parade
programme.desc: Plom, Phoebe, Mae-Mae, Hooper, Zip, and Fly are a group of unique paper friends who live in Pop Paper City. They find new ways to have fun, such as playing pirates, building theme parks and even exploring outer space.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Art
programme.desc: Pug wants to learn how to paint. Our heroes visit Picasso's studio in Paris.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Thirsty Robot
programme.desc: Messy monster can't work out why his cart won't move. The wheels just won't go round like normal. Off he goes to OKIDO to find out why.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Mr Kite Takes Flight
programme.desc: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy monster is just about to take a bite out of his delicious green sock for breakfast, but before he can it gets blown away! He goes to OKIDO to find out why the wind is so blowy.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to bake
programme.desc: Gran Gran and JoJo are excited to bake a batch of Great Gran Gran's signature Saint Lucian banana bread, but there's a problem - they don't know how long to bake it for!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to find a butterfly
programme.desc: JoJo searches for a butterfly to complete her nature tick-book. She learns that all butterflies start life as furry little caterpillars.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Old Toys
programme.desc: Duck is bored of his toy collection, so he and Sarah search for old toys in the attic.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Hair Cut
programme.desc: Sarah's hair keeps getting in her way, so it's time for a trip to the hairdressers.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Nia's Bright Idea
programme.desc: Nia uses what she learns about lighthouses to suggest covering a big wheel in Christmas lights, so that Harold can see where he's going in a storm.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bob Bilby
programme.desc: When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to show him a good time.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Spy Game
programme.desc: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game, their grown-up controlling device stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Takeaway
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Veggie Magic
programme.desc: When Evil Pea poses as a magician so that she can use tricks to make the Tato Team 'disappear', Supertato and Carrot create their own magical plan to rescue them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Biology Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels hop inside the Biology Bus and miniaturize themselves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Puddle Badge
programme.desc: Happy sets his sights on a questionable looking puddle that he is determined to splash in!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Matterhorn, Italy and Switzerland
programme.desc: Glitch gets into a mountain of trouble as the Go Jetters attempt to climb the Matterhorn.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bonneville Salt Flats, USA
programme.desc: Xuli and Glitch go head to head as they try to beat the Go Jet Academy land speed record.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia
programme.desc: Can the Go Jetters save the world's stinkiest plant from becoming Glitch's latest perfume?

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S1) - Orson's English Bakewell Tart
programme.desc: Orson is cooking his special version of Bakewell tart. To make things more exciting, he is throwing his friends an afternoon tea party with fancy dress. This is going to be fun!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Dusky Leaf Monkey
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Malaysia, South East Asia on a baby animal mission to find out why new born dusky leaf monkeys look so different to their parents.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S8) - Boom Family Reunion
programme.desc: In this episode Seaweed is missing his family, so Sandy organises a 'Boom' video call with his (and Captain Captain's) unusual relatives.

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Krash's New Friend
programme.desc: A beam of light sweeps through the window. Krash finds a glowing ball bouncing in the shop

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shaun
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a pet. To show them how much work they'd be in for, Dad gets to transform his hand into their old friend Shaun, a chaotic, undisciplined Emu with a taste for trouble.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Daddy Putdown
programme.desc: When Mum goes out to a baby shower, Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine. But with Bluey missing Mum, Dad has to pull out all the games he knows to keep them entertained.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Dance Mode
programme.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in "Dance Mode" as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Waltzing Potato
programme.desc: Evil Pea plans to freeze Supertato into an ice cube by pretending to teach him to dance.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: After many years as a respected actor and action choreographer, the Shaw Studio finally gave the dependable and commendable Hsu Hsia a chance to direct his own movies. He didn't waste the opportunity, inviting three other kung-fu designers to help on this fight-filled thriller. Wang Yu, co-star of such classics as Dirty Ho and The Kid With A Tattoo, here takes center stage as a young rascal caught between an anti-Ching Confederation and violent, vengeful Ching troops.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the "Full Moon Scimitar", on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - The Eternal Knight Pt. 2
programme.desc: To end the Eternal Night, Jim and the Trollhuntersmust risk everything in their battle against Gunmar.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Escape From The Darklands
programme.desc: Toby, Claire, and Blinky work to keep the human world unaware of Jim’s absence as they look for ways to rescue him from the Darklands

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - The Black Paladin
programme.desc: Voltron charges toward Zarkon's massive ship. When Shiro loses control of the Black Lion, the team must figure out a new way to defeat the Galra.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Across The Universe
programme.desc: Team Voltron is left scattered with Shiro and Keith on a lava planet, Pidge stranded on a garbage nebula, and Coran and Allura trapped in a wormhole

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Cowboy Next Door
programme.desc: When the annual roundup and town dance brings cowboy Javier to Miradero Lucky finds a new friend who can teach her and Spirit a new trick.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Rhino Charges
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Rhino didn't charge and he couldn't see very well at all. Poor old Rhino really wanted to be invited to the Dance of the Horns up on the plains with Buffalo and all the other horned animals. But Rhino didn't have a horn, so he wasn't allowed. The Monkeys decide to help Rhino and make him a horn from a piece of old wood. But when Rhino wakes up he doesn't know what it is. ‘Aargh! Thing on the end of my nose! CHAAaarge!' And that's Why Rhino Charges.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Caterpillar Is Never In A Hurry
programme.desc: You see Caterpillar was never in a hurry. When all the animals were racing around Tinga Tinga getting ready for the Best-dressed parade, Caterpillar was happy to sit in a tree and munch on leaves saying ‘Po-le, po-le, slowly, slowly, good things come to those who wait'. Then one day the rains come and Caterpillar disappears into a cocoon. ‘What's happening?' questions Elephant. ‘Wait and see' says Tortoise wisely ‘Wait and See'.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Horse Powered Dinkie
programme.desc: Farmer Green tells the cars about olden days, when the only transport was horse and cart. Maxi and Drifter say they would never be seen travelling that slow… or would they?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - FB's Sleepover
programme.desc: FB is excited about his sleepover with the other cars in the workshop but when the night draws in he is unsure of his unfamiliar surroundings. Big Chris helps set him at his ease

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cici Spectacular
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has asked CiCi to perform one of her stunts in front of a big crowd. CiCi is very nervous and Roary does his best to help his friend prepare for the event.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cry Cold
programme.desc: Big Chris is feeling ill so Marsha sends him to bed until he is better. Big Chris enjoys the attention rather too much and fails to let everyone know when he is on the mend.

programme.title: Landmarks - Royal Spring
programme.desc: A gem on India's tiara, Kashmir, Royal Springs is an exercise in class and sophistication. Royal Springs is not just beauty, but also sophistication par excellence.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus - Nicosia
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici unravels the stories of Nicosia, the cultural heartbeat of Cyprus, through her experiences.

programme.title: Backpack India - Badami, India

programme.title: World Heritage - Portugal
programme.desc: The stupendous architecture of Portugal’s monuments reveals the various stages of the country’s evolution.

programme.title: Xplore Ireland - Dublin
programme.desc: Pubs in Ireland are more than a place to drink; they’re centers of cultural gatherings and the nucleus of Irish ‘craic’.

programme.title: Travel Diaries Of Healer and Rohan - Nag Tibba
programme.desc: Situated on the foothills of Uttarakhand’s Garhwal mountains, Nag Tibba is a popular trekking destination.

programme.title: Taco To Tikka - Lucknow
programme.desc: Charlie’s journey through Lucknow’s kitchens takes him straight into the city’s royal legacy.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus - Khirokitia

programme.title: Backpack India - Hampi, India
programme.desc: Sommer Shiels is transported to the golden era of the Vijayanagar empire through the temples of Hampi.

programme.title: World Heritage - Ancient Temple of Egypt
programme.desc: From the stories of famous Egyptian pharaohs to Greco-Roman beliefs, the ancient temples of Egypt contain mysteries waiting to unfold.

programme.title: Xplore Ireland - Galway

programme.title: Travel Diaries Of Healer and Rohan - Kanatal

programme.title: Taco To Tikka - Varanasi

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus - Paphos

programme.title: Backpack India - Kabini, India

programme.title: City Breaks - Dubai
programme.desc: From bizarre theme parks to the world’s largest man-made marina, Sabrina Bussandri visits Dubai’s surreal attractions.

programme.title: Xplore Ireland - Wild Atlantic Way

programme.title: Travel Diaries Of Healer and Rohan - Rishikesh

programme.title: Taco To Tikka - Patna

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus - Akamas National Park

programme.title: Backpack India - Kozhikode & Alleppey, India
programme.desc: Sommer Shiels gets a sneak peek into the traditions, culture and beliefs of Alleppey, during a houseboat sojourn.

programme.title: Travel Diaries Of Healer and Rohan - Jim Corbett

programme.title: Taco To Tikka - Kolkata

programme.title: Unwind - Park Hyatt, Maldives

programme.title: Backpack India - Kochi, India

programme.title: The King Of Snooker - EP4
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant.

programme.title: Brick Slaves - EP14
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work.

programme.title: The Runner - EP24
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP10
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon - EP10
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins.

programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon - EP12
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP3
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues.
